name: Boundary pulse (measurement fixture)
material_note: Measurement fixture; flesh so a reach sweep measures GEOMETRY and nothing else — the multiplier is 1.10 and constant across every probe.

pulse.note: A ONE-FRAME hitbox with an 8 m radius. RI-CMB01 M2 asks for exactly this: 'enemy scripted to activate a 1-frame hitbox exactly on frame press + k'. The radius is deliberately large so that GEOMETRY is never the variable — the only thing that can decide hit/no-hit is whether the player's i-frame window was open on that frame, which is what M2 measures. poise_damage is 0 so a stagger cannot confound the run, and the damage is small so the player survives the whole sweep.

provenance.what: A MEASUREMENT FIXTURE, not a game enemy. It never appears in a scenario a player could reach, and it is declared here rather than special-cased in the probe so that the number a critic reads (8.0 m) is inspectable in the data tree instead of buried in a tool.

_armour_rating_note: Seam S19's consuming system for `corrode` (RI-MAG06 §B: "the rating falls"). A flat subtraction from every incoming damage number, applied in combat/resolve.js at the one site damage is computed. It was 0 everywhere in wave 1, which meant `corrode` had nothing to corrode and measured NOT_OBSERVED. Provisional: RI-CMB01 owns armour as a fight quantity and may re-derive every figure here.
